name: Shipping
project_description: Shipping is the umbrella module for Arch delivery. It defines a 'shipping_method' plugin type (managed by ShippingMethodManager, discovered from Plugin/ShippingMethod with the @ShippingMethod annotation) so other modules can supply delivery options. Each method decides its availability for an order (via hook_shipping_method_access) and computes its own price server-side through the Arch price factory. Store admins enable, disable, order and configure the available shipping methods from /admin/store/settings/shipping-methods.
